Hi Emily — for a grand opening in November 2026 (month pillar Geng-Zi, year Bing-Wu), we work from your Jia-Xu year and its na yin element, Shan Tou Huo ("fire on the mountaintop"). Your branch Xu forms a Three Harmony with the year's Wu, which gives the whole year a supportive backdrop. Chen days clash with Xu, so those are the ones to skip. The best picks are days whose branch harmonises with Xu (Mao for the Liu He pair; Yin and Wu for the Three Harmony) and whose element feeds your fire.

Here are the strongest windows by Four Pillars principles:

**[4 November 2026]** — Day pillar: Ren-Wu · Why: Wu completes the Three Harmony with your Xu · Why it suits you: its na yin is Yang Liu Mu (wood), and wood feeds fire — a natural boost for a launch · Watch out: keep the ceremony to the morning; the afternoon is better for quiet setup.

**[12–13 November 2026]** — Day pillars: Geng-Yin, Xin-Mao · Why: Yin joins your Three Harmony, and Mao is your Liu He partner · Why it suits you: both days are Song Bai Mu (pine wood), steady fuel for your fire — probably the best pair this month · Watch out: don't stack big supplier negotiations on the same day as the opening.

**[16 November 2026]** — Day pillar: Jia-Wu · Why: another Wu day in your Three Harmony · Why it suits you: Sha Zhong Jin (metal) is what your fire controls — traditionally read as wealth you can shape · Watch out: a good day for sales and promotions, less so for long-term contracts.

**[24–25 November 2026]** — Day pillars: Ren-Yin, Gui-Mao · Why: Yin and Mao again, so both harmonies line up · Why it suits you: Jin Bo Jin (gold-leaf metal) brings the same "wealth" reading, in a lighter form · Watch out: end-of-month cash flow can be tight, so finish payments beforehand.

Days to avoid: the 2nd (Geng-Chen), 14th (Ren-Chen) and 26th (Jia-Chen) — Chen clashes with your Xu. These suggestions come from five-element and branch harmony/clash principles, not from a printed almanac, so check a traditional calendar for auspicious hours before you lock in a date. Wishing you a busy, prosperous opening!
